description: This file defines the JobExecutionException class, a custom exception for handling multiple errors during job execution within the Fineract project. It extends MultiException and provides static methods to throw aggregated errors based on a map of throwables.

classes.name: JobExecutionException
classes.description: A custom exception class to handle multiple failures related to job execution, capable of aggregating error messages and causes.

methods.name: JobExecutionException
methods.description: Constructs a JobExecutionException with a message and list of problems.

methods.name: JobExecutionException
methods.description: Constructs a JobExecutionException with a list of throwable problems.

methods.name: JobExecutionException
methods.description: Constructs a JobExecutionException from another MultiException instance.

methods.name: throwErrors
methods.description: Static method to process a map of errors and their associated contexts, build an appropriate message, and throw a JobExecutionException if errors exist.
